name: Async field check
summary: A status line under a field for checks that need the server, such as "Checking", "Available" or "Taken, try ...".
description: Call Vectra.fieldState from your own code as the person types: there is no hook, because only you know what to check and where. An invalid result also blocks the form from submitting until the check passes.

classes.name: v-field-status
classes.description: The status line, with a spinner, a tick or an alert mark. Created by fieldState when missing; hidden while empty.

states.description: Set by fieldState: "checking" (spinner), "valid" (success tick) or "invalid" (danger mark).
Set on the input for an invalid result, with a custom validity error so the form will not submit.
The status line is linked while it has a message, and unlinked when cleared.

api.description: state is "checking", "valid", "invalid" or "clear". Writes the message under the input's .v-field and announces it politely.

a11y: Each message is announced politely and linked to the input, so screen readers hear the result without moving focus.
Every state has its own mark as well as colour, so "taken" never relies on red alone.
Only fieldState undoes its own aria-invalid, so an error from data-v-validate stays until that is fixed.
Wait for a short pause in typing (a debounce) before checking, so the line does not flicker on every key.
